name: comments
title: Comments
description: Comment section block built from Standard pieces: a heading with a Newest/Oldest sort select, a reply textarea with its submit button inside, a Login or Subscribe prompt for signed-out visitors, and a list of comments with avatars and relative times. Controlled or uncontrolled sort, async onSubmit that clears the box when it resolves, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to post, and an empty state.
